# SpaceCorps Developers · LLM Agent Index

> Integration guides, SDK references, and sandbox environments for autonomous agents and developer tooling.

- Developer Hub: https://spacecorps.github.io/developers.html
- Markdown Guide: https://spacecorps.github.io/developers.md
- Free Community Tier: https://spacecorps.github.io/pricing.md
- LLM Index: https://spacecorps.github.io/llms.txt
- Agent Skills: https://spacecorps.github.io/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json

## Quickstart
Integrate directly with native Rust binaries:
```bash
# Install tool via cargo or binary
cargo install spacecorps-cli
```
Connect via Model Context Protocol (MCP) stream:
- Manifest: `https://spacecorps.github.io/server.json`
- Discovery Card: `https://spacecorps.github.io/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json`
